item.title: Help Me Hera: How do I make friends with New Zealanders?
item.description: I moved here three years ago, and I’ve yet to make any local mates. What am I doing wrong? Summer read – originally published May 29 2025. Want Hera’s help? Email your problem to helpme@thespinoff.co.nz Dear Hera, I’m not from New Zealand, but I’ve been here for almost three years. In that time I’ve met plenty of fun and charming Kiwis but haven’t really made that many local friends. item.description: Yes, defence minister Judith Collins still says ‘talofa’. Summer read – originally published August 21 2025. item.description: Aotearoa loves a good haka – as long as it’s on a rugby field and not the floor of parliament. Summer read – originally published May 15 2025. item.description: Fighting on the streets of Beirut, recipes written on scraps of paper and a daring escape from near-certain death: the story of how Phoenician Falafel got its menu. item.title: My crummy old flat, with my crummy old furniture, just sold for $1,980,000
item.description: It has no insulation, flaking paint, questionable pipes and all my old furniture and artwork. At the auction, bidding was competitive.
